paper.title: Thompson Sampling in Non-Episodic Restless Bandits

settings.name_in_paper: Non-episodic (infinite time horizon) restless multi-armed bandit with policy mapping
settings.out_of_scope_reason: Restless Markov arms (POMDP/average-reward MDP formulation); markovian environments are out of scope in ontology v0.5.
unmapped: Each arm has a finite Markov state with unknown active/passive transition matrices; reward is a known deterministic function r_k(s) in [0,1] of the observed state
Learner observes the states of the N active arms each round
Regret is against the policy mu(theta*) given by a known deterministic policy mapping mu (e.g. Whittle index, myopic, best fixed arms)
The learner knows the mixing time T^mix(1/4) of the passive chains (passive chains irreducible and aperiodic)
The learner knows the policy mapping mu, the reward functions and the initial meta-state
Bounded span assumption (Condition 2) for every theta and pi_theta, with uniform span bound H
settings.definition_quote: At each time step $t$, the learner selects $N$ arms from $[K]$ which become \textit{active} while the others remain \textit{passive}. ... For all the chosen arms, the learner observes the state $s^t_k$ and receives a reward $r_k(s^t_k)$, where the rewards are deterministic \textit{known} functions of the state $r_k : S_k \rightarrow [0, 1]$

algorithms.name: TSDE in restless bandits (Thompson Sampling with Dynamic Episodes)

conditions: Assumption 1: passive chains irreducible and aperiodic with known mixing time
Assumption 2: bounded span (Condition 2) for every theta and pi_theta = mu(theta)
theta* drawn from known prior Q

source.label: thm:main
source.quote: The Bayesian regret of TSDE satisfies the following bound \begin{align*} BR(T) = \bigO(\sqrt{T} \log T), \end{align*} where the exact upper bound appears later in Sec. \ref{sec:regret}.

results.notes: Comparator is the policy mu(theta*) from the given policy mapping, measured via its long-term average reward J. Unknown T handled by doubling trick per remark.

symbols.H_span: uniform upper bound on the span of the bias function, sup_theta C_theta
symbols.S_sum: sum over arms of the number of states, sum_k |S_k|
symbols.T_mix: (log_2 T) * T^mix(1/4), with T^mix(1/4) the max mixing time of passive chains; O(log T)
symbols.m: number N of arms activated each round
